item_reviews.comment: T1 averages 12.0 to 15.1 give a 3.1 BLEU gain; this is the main result.
P2 reports 5.8 average BLEU on four low-resource pairs; 5.8−3.1=2.7. Different setup, so the comparison is descriptive.
T1 per-pair differences are 3.1, 2.4, 4.0 and 2.9, all positive.
T2 average chrF rose from 39.0 to 42.3, which supports the claim.
BLEU 15.1 vs 13.4 gives 1.7. chrF 42.3 vs 40.3 gives 2.0. Both are correct.
The package states single runs and no statistical tests, so the caveat is supported and relevant.

missing_core_findings.description: The roughly 6 BLEU gain attributed to Ambergate & Toivonen (2022) is not supported by their cited passage P1, which states no gain. The usable baseline is P2's 5.8 BLEU, so the comparison rests on P2, not the often-cited figure.

The previously reported gain for unfiltered back-translation was 2.9 BLEU (P2). Wickersham-MT's unfiltered gain was 1.4 (13.4 vs 12.0). Both the filtered and unfiltered gains are smaller than previously reported.
